basis: Spinal, neurodevelopmental and persistent pigmentary abnormalities define symptomatic cases; most mosaics are normal. Cardiac/renal anomalies are 5-29%; constipation alone adds no axis.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: persistent pigmentary skin abnormalities are explicitly defining features; the functional-damage requirement applies to involved organs.

basis: Skeletal malformations and microcephaly (7/7) characterize this subtype. Hearing impairment in 1/1 supports otologic involvement, although population frequency is uncertain.

decisions.neurologic: primary: microcephaly in 7/7 and reported intellectual disability characterize the subtype's neurodevelopmental phenotype.
decisions.otologic: involved: hearing impairment is reported in 1/1; this supports involvement with limited confidence, rather than establishing a defining ear phenotype.

basis: Retinopathy, intellectual disability and endocrine dysfunction define the syndrome; sensorineural deafness occurs in 80-99%. Skin and skeletal abnormalities omitted at the four-axis cap.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: hypogonadism and insulin-resistant diabetes are defining endocrine disorders, both reported in 80-99%.
decisions.otologic: involved: defining sensorineural deafness occurs in 80-99%; retained here because primary is capped at three and the endocrine mechanism requires primary status.

basis: Spastic paraplegia occurs in 10/10 and peripheral conduction abnormalities in 9/9. Weakness is neurogenic; no distinct metabolic abnormality is established by the supplied evidence.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: mitochondrial inheritance alone does not establish an inborn metabolic disorder; the supplied evidence establishes central and peripheral neurologic disease.

basis: Prototheca infection directly infiltrates skin in approximately 50-70% of cases. Bursitis and individual disseminated organ sites generally affect fewer than 30%.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: direct cutaneous infection occurs in approximately 50-70%; this umbrella infection also includes bursal and disseminated presentations.

basis: Collodion/ichthyotic storage disease; pancytopenia 80-99% and hepatic infiltration/cholestasis 30-79%. Contractures and ectropion omitted at the four-axis cap.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: collodion-type skin disease is a defining named manifestation, supported by ichthyosis in 80-99% and congenital ichthyosiform erythroderma in 6/6.

basis: Inherited dyskinetic movement disorder. Hypothyroidism in 2/6 (~33%) lacks established direct attribution to this disease; cardiomyopathy in 1/6 (~17%) is below threshold.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: hypothyroidism in 2/6 meets the numerical threshold, but the evidence does not establish direct endocrine damage from this dyskinesia rather than a separate diagnosis.

basis: Endocrine neoplasia and oral/enteric neural proliferation define MEN2B. Structural skeletal abnormalities and joint laxity occur in approximately 65-75%; tall habitus alone is insufficient.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: structural skeletal abnormalities and joint laxity affect approximately 65-75%; persistent deformities support this axis beyond tall or slender habitus.

basis: Renal failure causes retention of uremic toxins. Separately diagnosed neuropathy, pericarditis and other variable complications do not justify additional axes.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: retained metabolic waste reflects failed renal clearance; it does not independently establish an endocrine or metabolic disease.

basis: Cutaneous histiocytic proliferation causes characteristic dermal papules. Blood abnormalities occur in 5-29%; leukemia is a separate disease reported in 1-4%.

decisions.haematologic: none: tissue histiocytes proliferate in skin; hematopoietic lineage alone does not establish blood or marrow disease. Blood abnormalities are occasional.
